- **Red:** the test file at `6414b6c20` against the code at `24694ced5`, the parent commit.

| a running queue run whose gate passes during the bounded wait is proof | `false !== true` (line 117) |
| a new attempt of a running queue run during the final read invalidates its proof | got `reason: 'source-pending'`, expected `'source-changed'` (line 122) |

With the fix, all tests in the file pass.

> Red/green proof (`squeal proof .github/scripts/queue-ci-proof.test.cjs --base 6414b6c2^`): the 3 new tests fail on the parent commit and pass with this change.
